title: Applied Materials Q2 fiscal 2026 results furnished on Form 8-K
excerpt: Applied reported record fiscal Q2 revenue of USD 7.91 billion, GAAP gross margin of 49.9%, and GAAP diluted EPS of USD 3.51.
summary: Current primary results for the quarter ended 2026-04-26. Revenue rose 11% to USD 7.91 billion, GAAP operating margin reached 31.9%, and GAAP diluted EPS rose 33% to USD 3.51. Semiconductor Systems revenue rose 10% to USD 5.965 billion and AGS revenue rose 17% to USD 1.665 billion. Operating cash flow was USD 845 million but non-GAAP free cash flow fell 80% to USD 210 million. Management expects fiscal Q3 revenue of USD 8.95 billion plus or minus USD 500 million and non-GAAP diluted EPS of USD 3.36 plus or minus USD 0.20.
